templates.name: Networking introduction
templates.body: Hi {{Name}}, I’m exploring senior business systems, program operations, and change/adoption roles in {{Market}}. My background combines executive nonprofit leadership, systems implementation, data/reporting, and stakeholder communication. If you have 15 minutes, I’d value your perspective on {{Company}} and the problems its team is hiring to solve.

templates.body:
Subject: Follow-up — {{Role}}, {{Company}}

Hello {{Name}},

I’m following up on my application for {{Role}} submitted on {{Date}}. The role’s focus on {{Priority}} aligns closely with my experience in operations leadership, systems improvement, and cross-functional implementation. I remain very interested and would welcome a conversation about the team’s priorities.

Best,
Latisha Vincent-Waters
